displayDescription: A line-drawn bulb sparks and extends its contours into a hatched, connected network on an ink-teal field.
styleRenderer: Tonal Hatching and Crosshatching (procedural SVG hatch strokes)
limitations: Tonal hatching is procedural SVG line hatching clipped to ring bands, not a shader or lighting model.
tldraw, Rough.js, Paper.js and Motion were not used: the clean, jitter-free monoline style is fully served by SVG + DrawSVGPlugin, with one motion owner per property.
Caption word reveal uses fill-opacity on tspans; Helvetica Neue falls back to Helvetica/Arial when unavailable.
STYLE.json lists no preview_recipes, so the refresh demonstrates the primary Line Art style.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA pending.
